non_blocking.section: Pros and cons of the options (CRDs read by every Node)
non_blocking.suggestion: Line 156 says "each Node would add ten CRD informers". Pack section 3 and the Configuration model Kubernetes mapping make `Cluster` control plane only, "read only by Ruralz Control". A file-mode Node would need at most the eight Bundle kinds, plus `Environment` for `${VAR}` values. A word-neutral fix: "each Node would add eight Bundle-kind informers to the EndpointSlice informers it already holds".

Line 41 cites https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/client-go/informers/discovery/v1 for "dynamic informers, a list-and-watch per kind". That page covers typed EndpointSlice informers, not dynamic informers. Rephrase to "through client-go informers, as for EndpointSlices" so the research URL supports the claim.

Line 51 says "Server-set `metadata` and `status` are dropped; otherwise only the group changes". The Configuration model rejects `metadata.namespace` in the Bundle form, and `metadata.namespace` is not server-set. Consider "Server-set `metadata`, `metadata.namespace` and `status` are dropped" (one extra word).
Line 162 says "client-go is linked into both binaries". Ruralz has three binaries. Say "into `ruralzd` and `ruralz-control`" to match the tech stack catalog row.

The body is about 1,497 words by the verifier's rule, against a 1,500 maximum. Any edit, including the ones above, must be word-neutral or offset elsewhere. Do not trim the text that resolved the earlier L2-1 to L2-3 findings (lines 45, 104, 118, 119, 138, 162).

foundation_amendments: Configuration model (Kubernetes mapping): say that some `x-ruralz-validations` rules may not lower to `x-kubernetes-validations` (no structural equivalent, over the CEL cost budget, or using Ruralz-only variables) and then run only in Ruralz Control. The ADR's More information proposes this.
Configuration model: open an Open question on which tool-managed labels and annotations (kubectl last-applied-configuration, Helm, Argo CD) the CRD-to-Bundle translation drops before the digest.
Deployment topologies: open an Open question on how a namespace source signals a complete object set: (a) debounce only; (b) an expected object-set digest.
